changeset.li: New upstream version, the one of Debian Forky, with Debian's patches and the options of Debian's rules, without systemd, udev and cryptsetup

Packages as in Debian: util-linux, util-linux-extra, bsdutils, bsdextrautils, eject, fdisk, login, rfkill, lastlog2, liblastlog2-2, liblastlog2-dev and libpam-lastlog2 are new, with Debian's PAM files for login, su and runuser. setpriv and findmnt are in util-linux
su, mount, umount and newgrp are setuid, as in Debian
uuid-runtime has uuidparse and no systemd units
Upgrade to version from Debian Bullseye
Upgrade to latest version from Debian Buster.
Adaptation of Debian sources for Bolt OS
